text:
The median asking rent in Duisburg stands at 8.49 €/m², up 4.9 % year‑on‑year and 27.6 % over the last five years, placing the city 34th of the 37 most expensive German markets. The spread between the 25th and 75th percentiles (7.5 – 9.57 €/m²) shows modest dispersion, while the asking premium over existing rents is 45 % (5.84 €/m² versus 8.49 €/m²).

Market tightness is reflected in a balanced outlook with a 2.4 % vacancy rate, 35 days on market and 19 % of listings let within a week. A 60 m² unit costs about 509 € per month, generating a rent‑burden of 14.5 % for two residents.

The model‑based 12‑month forecast expects the median asking rent to reach 8.95 €/m² (range 8.71 – 9.08 €/m²), a 5.4 % increase, assuming current mortgage rates of 4.09 % and continued modest population growth of 0.9 % over five years.
